description: An upload address for the files a change request will carry, in one project: a design's own files (HTML, CSS, scripts, fonts, pictures) as ONE .zip of the folder, which CodeGene checks (files that hold passwords or keys, source maps and anything not part of a design are left out, with the reason) and its Builder unpacks beside its work; or a picture, PDF or recording. PUT each file to uploadUrl before expiresAt (the curl field; add ?name= to name it). Each upload answers attachment.id (att_...): pass the ids as request_change attachments, for the same project. Treat uploadUrl like a password until it expires.

project_id.description: The project the change is for (list_projects gives ids).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: upload_task_files
title: Get an address to upload files for a change request
